reason: Fixed potential infinite loop issue in I2C_WaitOnFlagUntilTimeout. The function contains a while loop that waits for I2C hardware flags (__HAL_I2C_GET_FLAG) which would cause infinite blocking in emulation without real hardware. Modified to skip the hardware flag waiting loop while preserving timeout checking and error state management logic. This allows the emulation to proceed without getting stuck waiting for hardware flags that will never change in the emulated environment.
